acceptanceCriteria: A fixture mocking an index.ts barrel re-exporting the subject yields JS-SUBJECT-MOCKED, or abstains with a named reason when the barrel cannot be resolved; never JS-BOUNDARY-MOCKED.
Aliased imports (import {x as y}) of the subject are recognized, pinned by a test.
body: Found in V1-1858 (PR #1161, head 2817789aa, corvint build 664). Expected: mocking a barrel module that re-exports the subject counts as JS-SUBJECT-MOCKED. Actual: it is reported as JS-BOUNDARY-MOCKED or not at all. Suspected misclassification, not yet reproduced on an external repo.
title: JS/TS hygiene: subject detection misses re-exports and import aliases (barrel mocks misclassified)
